results.name: Aha Co-LAB
results.description: A roundtable think-tank at Quietude where teachers, artists and wellness entrepreneurs swap ideas and support each other around healing arts and life-affirming business.
results.notes: Peer conversation circle rather than sales networking; grey, kept. No own website found (not searched).

results.name: asheBUILT
results.description: A networking group for commercial building and trades professionals that hosts monthly happy hours and mixers.
results.notes: Industry business-development networking.

results.name: Asheville Bad*ss Womxn Unite
results.description: A social group for women and womxn that meets for brunches, gallery walks and nights out around Asheville.
results.notes: Meetup events through May 2026; none upcoming.

results.name: Asheville Cannabis, Entheogens and Healing
results.description: A Meetup that hosts ticketed cannabis sound-healing ceremonies led by a facilitator.
results.notes: Single event; practitioner-run ceremony with limited paid spaces and no evident member community.

results.name: Asheville Drum Circle
results.description: A long-running open drum circle in Pritchard Park where regulars and newcomers drum, dance and listen together on Friday evenings through the warmer months.
results.notes: Community tradition since 2001 (Explore Asheville, Our State). Open to all, but a recognised standing community; kept as grey.

results.name: Asheville Human Design Meetup Group
results.description: A community for people interested in Human Design that gathers for hands-on, discussion-based sessions on type and strategy.
results.notes: Two events Feb-Mar 2026; none since.

results.name: Asheville Mountains-to-Sea Trail Hiking Club
results.description: A hiking club that walks sections of the Mountains-to-Sea Trail and nearby routes at a brisk pace. Well-behaved leashed dogs are welcome.
results.notes: 72 Meetup events since Dec 2025, latest late Sept 2026.

results.name: Asheville Runners
results.description: A casual running club with weekly group runs of 1, 3 or 6 miles followed by drinks and socializing, including a Tuesday brewery run series.
results.home_base: Olde London Road, River Arts District
results.notes: 89 Meetup events, 3 upcoming.

results.name: Asheville Storytellers Dining Out
results.description: A small social group for storytelling fans that meets for dinners and gathers before local Moth StorySLAM nights.
results.notes: New group, two events in Aug 2026. Grey; kept.

results.name: Asheville's Bored Game Geeks
results.description: A board game group that meets for weeknight game nights at local breweries and cideries. Bring a game or learn one from members.
results.home_base: Archetype Brewing and Noble Cider, Asheville
results.notes: 41 Meetup events, 3 upcoming. Not checked against c:asheville-board-game-club.

results.name: avl.js
results.description: Asheville's JavaScript community, with talks, lightning talks and show-and-tell sessions for web developers of all levels.
results.notes: Seven Meetup events since March 2026, one upcoming.

results.name: Blue Country Line Dance
results.description: A queer-led, inclusive line dancing community that holds lessons and dances for all skill levels, including a regular all-ages brunch dance at The Grey Eagle.
results.notes: Search results show website, Instagram @bluecountrylinedance, instructor Zoe Hawkins-Wells. Venue-hosted events but a distinct dance community.

results.name: Carolina Women+ In Tech Asheville
results.description: The Asheville chapter of a women+ in tech community offering networking, education and support for engineers, entrepreneurs and career changers.
results.notes: Only the May 2026 launch mixer so far; chapter of a regional group. Not the same as m:avltech.

results.name: Community Listening Circle
results.description: A free, trauma-informed online listening circle offering space for post-Helene healing, connection and reflection.
results.notes: Weekly Mountain Xpress listings Jan-Jul 2026, none since; organizer unclear.

results.name: Dealmaker WNC
results.description: A local chapter of a national real estate investor networking community.
results.notes: Chapter-style deal-making and lead-generation networking.

results.name: Emotional Health Meetup Group
results.description: A reflective discussion group on emotional patterns, using mindful awareness and compassion in honest, gentle conversation.
results.notes: Two events Dec 2025-Jan 2026. Grey, possibly facilitator-led; kept.

results.name: First Congregational UCC Game Night
results.description: A monthly casual game night of cards, dominoes and Rummikub for fun and friendship. No experience needed.
results.notes: Seven monthly listings Dec 2025-Jun 2026 from the church.

results.name: Gravelo Workshop Group Ride
results.description: A weekly no-drop mixed-surface group ride from Gravelo Workshop, sometimes co-hosted with Rockgeist Social Club. Route length varies by season.
results.notes: Standing weekly ride with 60 listings and 25 upcoming; keep per shop-ride rule.

results.name: HikeWNC 30's, 40's, 50's
results.description: A hiking group for people in their 30s to 50s that does non-competitive group hikes around western North Carolina.
results.notes: One Meetup event in Dec 2025; age-based hiking group.

results.name: Irish Jam with Tim Griffin
results.description: A monthly Irish music session where musicians of all levels bring fiddles, whistles and guitars to play reels and jigs together. Listeners are welcome.
results.notes: Open session with regular players; matches other kept jam/session groups. Not a duplicate of other venues' sessions.

results.name: Kenilworth Artists Association
results.description: A neighborhood artists' association in Asheville's Kenilworth area that runs an annual free, self-guided studio tour of its member artists.
results.notes: Standing member association with own site (from earlier research); events are annual.

results.name: Liberty Bicycles Thursday MTB Ride
results.description: A weekly Thursday evening group mountain bike ride from Liberty Bicycles, with trail and difficulty changing each week.
results.notes: Standing weekly ride; separate from the shop's Slow-cial and Urban Cruise rides.

results.name: Meditation for Spiritual Awareness Asheville
results.description: A free meditation community running online webinars and learn-to-meditate classes on spiritual awareness, in the Science of Spirituality tradition.
results.notes: 168 Meetup events, mostly Science of Spirituality webinars; website is the national org's, not a local page.

results.name: Mindful Meet & Mingle Asheville Singles
results.description: A singles group that hosts mindful, conversation-focused mixers and game nights for people looking to connect.
results.home_base: Land of the Sky UCC, Asheville
results.notes: Events are application-based and paid, but it is a singles social group with recurring attendees; grey, kept.

results.name: Next Gen at YMI Cultural Center
results.description: A community group that hosts the monthly Art After Dark social at the YMI Cultural Center, celebrating Black art and social life.
results.notes: Grey_unresolved. Search found nothing on Next Gen beyond YMI listings; kept per leniency rule but weak.

results.name: Old-Time Jam with Marc Rudow
results.description: A monthly old-time music jam led by Marc Rudow where fiddle, banjo and guitar players of all levels trade tunes. Listeners are welcome.
results.notes: Different from the other old-time jams in the index (other venues/leaders).

results.name: Platonic Snuggles
results.description: A consent-centered, gently guided gathering for platonic touch and connection, with guided activities before optional cuddling.
results.notes: Ticketed (Zeffy) facilitator-run events, but a recurring Meetup community with ten events; grey, kept.

results.name: Recovery Dharma
results.description: A peer-led recovery community that uses Buddhist teachings and meditation to support anyone working with addiction. Meets twice a week at Urban Dharma.
results.notes: 220 listings from Urban Dharma, Friday and Sunday night meetings; national org site.

results.name: Senior Singles Fun Bunch
results.description: A social group for senior singles that meets for meals, tours, music and outings around Asheville and Hendersonville.
results.notes: 12 Meetup events, 2 upcoming. Separate from Active Single Seniors.

results.name: Skyland Library Knitting & Crochet Club
results.description: A drop-in knitting and crochet circle at the Skyland library where makers work on their own projects and chat. All skill levels welcome.
results.notes: 17 listings from Buncombe County Libraries; matches library club siblings.

results.name: Steppin' Out AVL
results.description: A volunteer-run, free and inclusive country western line dancing and two-stepping community with lessons and dances for all levels.
results.notes: Own site steppinoutavl.org; founded 2023; weekly at Banks Ave plus monthly at Hi-Wire.

results.name: Tai Chi Kung
results.description: A single donation-based outdoor tai chi kung workshop with partner work in Pack Square Park.
results.notes: One workshop led by an instructor; no sign of a standing member community.

results.name: The Shifties
results.description: A monthly no-drop social bike ride on mixed surfaces that rolls out from Burial Beer's South Slope taproom.
results.notes: Eleven monthly listings through Nov 2026; venue-hosted but standing ride.

results.name: Ultra Coffeebar Run Club
results.description: A Monday morning group run in the River Arts District for all paces, with coffee afterward.
results.notes: One Meetup event Aug 2026; coffee shop run club with regulars. Not the same as Asheville Runners.

results.name: Weaverville Women's Book Club
results.description: A book club for women that meets at Leveller Brewing in Weaverville to discuss a shared read over drinks.
results.notes: Five listings across several sources, one upcoming.

results.name: Wine Drinkers with a Reading Problem
results.description: A monthly book chat over wine where members bring any fiction or nonfiction pick tied to the month's topic.
results.notes: 11 Meetup events, 1 upcoming.

results.name: Womansong of Asheville
results.description: A long-running community women's chorus that rehearses and performs together and welcomes new singers through its Sing With Us page.
results.notes: Membership ensemble with own site; Eventbrite listings are spring concert.
